{{Otheruses|Adam}}
'''Adam Squadron''' was a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in service of the [[Dimok government]]. They attempted to attack an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] force that was trying to capture both [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] leaders, but were destroyed by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and one of his wingmen.
